node: Transmission-line hardware, fittings, clamps, connectors, and conductor-adjacent components
summary: Expanded the transmission-line hardware node into a focused 4-name universe. The strongest underfollowed direct candidate is Preformed Line Products, which maps closely to preformed wire/cable fittings, anchors, suspension and tension clamps, splice closures, and optical-fiber/OPGW-adjacent hardware. Hubbell is included as the obvious reference leader because its Utility Solutions segment explicitly sells T&D components and acquired DMC Power for high-voltage connectors/tooling. nVent and AZZ are second-order candidates: nVent through utility grounding, bonding, lightning protection, and power-connection components; AZZ through hot-dip galvanizing used in transmission and distribution steel infrastructure. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
